name: Somniloquy
body:
School enchantment [language-dependent, mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, druid 3, inquisitor 3, mesmerist 3, psychic 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.

Target one sleeping or unconscious creature
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You grant a form of consciousness to an unconscious creature, allowing it to answer questions. You may ask one question per two caster levels. The creature’s knowledge is limited to what it could possibly know or understand while awake, including the languages it spoke. Answers are brief, cryptic, tinged with dream oddities, or repetitive, especially if the creature would have opposed you in life.

If the creature would be unwilling while conscious, they may make a Will save. If successful, the creature can refuse to answer your questions or attempt to deceive you, using Bluff.
